name: Standard Notes
description_en:
Standard Notes is a product in the Note taking category. Its directory profile covers To-do List, Share Link, File Sharing, Task Tracking, Meetings, Version Control.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $4.17. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: make files available to authorized participants; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
